description: This file defines a mock class ControlServerInternalMock for unit testing, which implements the IControlServerInternal interface. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for controlling and testing interactions with control server internals within the Rialto project.

classes.name: ControlServerInternalMock
classes.description: A mock class for IControlServerInternal used in unit testing to simulate control server internal behaviors.
